prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: proposed canonical full-body doll reference for American Girl Doll Race. Create ONE beautiful photographic 18-inch vinyl play doll based on Charlie McGee, Drew Barrymore's character in the ORIGINAL 1984 movie FIRESTARTER. Recognizable character-inspired toy interpretation, not a photo of a human. Rounded young doll face, fair warm skin, large blue inset doll eyes, small nose, softly closed lips, quietly determined but approachable expression. Long honey-blonde rooted hair, loose soft waves and center part, swept gently back at the temples with a slight airy lift, compact enough for game poses. Character's iconic early-1980s outfit interpreted as miniature sewn doll clothing: pale pink long-sleeved collared blouse under a burgundy/maroon sleeveless pinafore jumper with fine narrow vertical pale stripes, knee-length skirt, white ankle socks and simple brown leather Mary Jane shoes. Keep a sturdy childlike play-doll body, rounded vinyl limbs and molded hands; head and body proportions like premium 18-inch dolls, no fashion-model proportions. Real fabric seams, tiny buttons, woven stripes, softly satin vinyl, natural detailed hair with clean edges. Full body from crown to shoe soles, neutral standing pose with arms relaxed slightly away from sides, hands empty and visible, feet planted, mostly frontal with slight turn to viewer's right. Soft even studio lighting, portrait composition, generous margins. TRUE fully transparent background, no haze, halo, studio backdrop, floor or shadow. No flames or fire effects for this canonical identity reference, no damage, no weapons, no props, no text, no watermark. One doll only, no sheet, no collage. Crisp polished toy art compatible with the game's Marisol canonical.
validation: Full body visually reviewed on cream and navy backgrounds; exact lossless RGBA WebP round-trip passed. No runtime changes.
